note: Verification coverage for the Crew write registry. THIS FILE IS ENFORCED, not descriptive: tests/meridian/test_write_coverage.py fails if a registered action type is missing here, if an entry no longer matches the registry, or if a readback entry's `check` string is not present in meridian/crew_write_actions.py. Adding a write operation therefore requires recording a verification decision, and no operation can silently lose or gain a verifier.

status_vocabulary.readback: a verifier re-reads fresh provider state after execution; the receipt is confirmed / contradicted / unresolved
status_vocabulary.none: no verifier is registered; a provider-accepted write ends EXECUTED with ok=null and provider_truth=false, and is never reported as verified

unresolved_receipt_rule: An accepted write whose readback is missing, partial, stale, malformed, timed-out or raising stays EXECUTED (ok=null, provider_truth=false, retry_allowed=false). It is never resubmitted, including after restart.

entries.note: Fresh complete provider snapshot; matched fields confirm, differing fields are a provider-confirmed contradiction, an absent bill is unresolved (never a confirmed deletion).
Fresh complete provider snapshot; compares requested name/amount/reservedAmount. Local commitments are no longer consulted.
Confirms the provider-generated bill id and the requested name/amount in a fresh complete snapshot.
Confirms the provider-generated pocket id and returned identity fields in a fresh complete snapshot.
Complete readback proving absence verifies; presence is a provider-confirmed failure; an incomplete readback never concludes a deletion.
Complete readback proving the bill is absent verifies; a still-present bill is a provider-confirmed failure.

Fresh complete provider snapshot; confirms the provider-returned transfer id appears on an observed transaction. Absence from a single read cannot confirm failure — only presence confirms success. Pagination may hide the transfer on an unobserved page, so the receipt stays unresolved when the transfer is not seen in the fetched page.

entries.reason: The provider snapshot exposes per-bill reservedAmount but no billReserveId, so a top-up cannot yet be attributed to the reserve it targeted.

entries.note: billReserve.fundingPlans on the expenses facet, added to the connector at bd7d8b1. Requires the provider-returned plan id; if the write returns none the receipt stays unresolved rather than matching by name.
Identified by the approved proposal's fundingPlanId, so it does not depend on the write result; compared on name and amount.
Identified by the approved proposal's fundingPlanId. Absence from a complete read confirms; presence is a provider-confirmed contradiction.
Rules facet, previously discarded. Requires the provider-returned rule id plus the requested name; a rule not yet visible stays unresolved.
Rules facet. Identified by the approved proposal's own rule id; absence from a complete read confirms, presence is a provider-confirmed contradiction.
family.reassignmentRules, added to the connector at bd7d8b1. Requires the provider-returned rule id; a rule not yet visible stays unresolved.
Identified by the approved proposal's reassignment_rule_id. An observed-empty list verifies; an unobserved facet never confirms a deletion.

Live-verified as user.userSpendConfig.selectedSpendSubaccount on each card, so no connector change is needed. Child cards are ignored; conflicting selections are reported unresolved rather than picked between.
Cards facet, which the connector always fetched and Meridian discarded. Requires the provider-returned card id; a card not yet visible stays unresolved, never a failure.

retired_action_types.reason: It was listed in ActionStore.allowed_types with no executor, so an approved action could only fail with error_code 'no_executor'. The root cause is that the connector exposes no write operation for it: src/crew_work_assistant/crew_write_cli.py and write_operations/ contain 18 write specs and no update_virtual_card. The capability to perform the write did not exist, so no readback verifier could have made it work.
retired_action_types.resolution: Removed from ActionStore.allowed_types in app.py, owner-authorized 2026-09-14. Recorded here rather than deleted so a future reader sees a deliberate retirement and not an omission.
retired_action_types.not_affected: create_crew_virtual_card is unaffected and remains verified by readback from the virtual_cards facet.
retired_action_types.would_reinstate_on: A connector write operation for the card update, plus a readback verifier and an owner decision.

engine_level_verifiers.note: Registered in app.py (verify_transfer_action), not in the Crew write registry; listed here so the coverage picture is complete.
Shares the move_money executor and verifier.
Local planning metadata only; never contacts Crew. A missing rule id records check 'missing-rule-id' with ok=false instead.
Local re-read of the created commitment.

Local planning records only; never contacts Crew. Refuses any commitment carrying a Crew bill id, which must travel archive_crew_bill so the change can be verified with the provider. Verifies the STORED status is archived rather than trusting the write, and a row that is missing is unverified rather than assumed. Archiving keeps the row and its history, which is what makes the control reversible.
